requirements.statement: Provide RDF representations of spatial metadata that conform to DCAT-AP, retain meaning as far as practical and support cross-domain reuse.
Include every mandatory baseline DCAT-AP element.
Use other vocabularies for geospatial information only where the baseline does not cover it.
Base alignments on established practice and working-group implementation experience.
Assess any new terms carefully and avoid conflicting with ongoing standardisation.
Cover the ISO core and common INSPIRE metadata elements; exclude only optional material where necessary, with theme-specific extensions outside the common scope.
Offer an additional RDF publication route while retaining the existing INSPIRE metadata obligations and implementations.

note: Seven scoped architectural/alignment constraints, not a complete domain-content gold. Keep architectural and metadata-content scores separate.
